name: Student
description: Learns fast. No strengths, no weaknesses — the baseline everything else is measured against.

name: Fighter
description: An extra weapon slot. More arms, more steel.

name: Rogue
description: Quick on their feet. Hits harder with Light weapons, worse with Heavy ones.

name: Mage
description: Attuned to Magic. Weapons carrying the Magic tag hit harder.

name: Priest
description: Recovers steadily and carries a healing prayer. Keeps everyone standing.

name: Marksman
description: Deadly with projectiles, slower on foot. Starts with a bow.

name: Looter
description: Gains 1 max health per item carried; the shop charges them a quarter more.

name: Vampire
description: Loses 1 health every second, forever. Starts with 15 lifesteal.

name: Sentinel
description: Slow and armored. Starts with more health and takes less from everything.
